name: type27-to-geojson-course-not-shared
reference: Type 27: the course is the raw key ais.course_lr, not course (pack.md), so properties holds speed_ms only. geojson writes coordinates [lon, lat], properties in field-line order (callsign, course, speed_ms), then id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); uid is derived as text_of(ais.mmsi) (model/ais.def), so it is checked with @complete.
